mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 74 degrees.

The City of Verona has officially adopted Envision Verona, a long-range comprehensive plan designed to guide housing, transportation, and economic development over the next decade. The plan focuses on creating strong neighborhoods and supporting our local downtown identity.

There is plenty to do in our community today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park and Wednesday Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can check out ART House 360 events tomorrow.
In our weekly report, on October 3, a 19-year-old Verona man was arrested following a traffic stop where officers discovered a stolen firearm in his vehicle.
Today's feature at Culver's is the delicious Turtle Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open for business and will be serving up treats until 10 PM tonight.
